arrival_ts:widen_hour.reason: At-risk rows only: hour widened to a 3-hour block.

k_target.reason: Every released ed_visits row shares its kept quasi-identifiers (date_of_birth, municipality, arrival_ts) with at least 4 other rows, and every such group holds at least 2 distinct icd10_primary values; only the rows that miss the target are coarsened, and rows still at risk get those columns suppressed.

fitness.rule: Share of the released rows whose combination of every kept value (every kept column except keyed tokens and free text) is shared by fewer than 5 rows, on the final release after the k repair. Reported for the fit-for-sharing statement; it decides nothing in selection.
